description: This file contains unit tests for the media pipeline miscellaneous functions in the Rialto server media pipeline component. It tests various functionalities such as play, stop, pause, set video window, set position, set playback rate, get position, render frame, volume, mute, and active request invalidation, primarily using Google Test framework with mock objects.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaPipelineMiscellaneousFunctionsTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from MediaPipelineTestBase, used for testing miscellaneous functions of the Rialto server media pipeline.

methods.name: RialtoServerMediaPipelineMiscellaneousFunctionsTest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test fixture and creates the media pipeline.

methods.name: ~RialtoServerMediaPipelineMiscellaneousFunctionsTest
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up the media pipeline.
